messages.subject: Default ShinyApp Template in RStudio
parts:
RStudio is awesome for project management and for developing ShinyApps. To start a new ShinyApp it is as easy as File -> New Project -> New ShinyApp 

However, I find that many of my ShinyApps share common elements, common packages, and a common look. I'd love to import these as defaults each time I start a new shiny app. Is it possible to change the default ui.R and server.R and other folder options when creating a New Project in R Studio? If so, how?
